notes.title: Game version update V.1.1
notes.content:
Hi, I'm the liquefaction producer, Grasshopper
I caught the new coronavirus again, and just had time at home to implement the game update I mentioned before. If I am lucky enough to have friends waiting for me to update this time, thank you for your support. I hope this update can optimize your experience a little bit.
1. Some UI updates, including self bar, button, selection box,  etc., hope to give you a bit of freshness
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136657/d0a17e9b7f52dc96787894ba9044ac646fff86fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136657/a7d73b21ec8509cd3b75546af3d0e9577d019ab5.png[/img]
2. Interactive update: Most of the interaction points in the game will be hidden once the whole dialogue is completed
3. Adjustment of Hexagon Street: Delete the relevant content of Hexagon Street, end the game after partial endings are completed;or send you to allay scene
4. Ending conditions: All ending conditions are written in the specimen information on the character interface, which is convenient to reach the ending according to the text prompts
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136657/051686151499148578dbf4a070bde5ad27bebe2f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136657/09d98004dc84bc6893d2a81068c2b2011be13c9c.png[/img]
5. Logic optimization:
(1) You have to complete a whole story with Todd to unlock the other two characters, which is the same as my original design
(2) Delete all the content that requires raw flasks to solve puzzles in the Todd and Emma scenes, and adjust the initial number of flasks in Albert to 6

notes.title: The Surreal reasoning and adventure game LIQUID is live now!
notes.content:
The game LIQUID officially releases. We will discount 10% off in the first week! Download and trial!

The strange murder case is beyond reality. Among times and spaces, fantasy and reality, the truth of everything is about the theme of the game: LIQUID. Can you find the answer?

Get on board our QQ group: 704526044. Witness different endings other players have had.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095130

notes.title: Demo Is Available Now!!
notes.content:
The Steam Next Fest is happening on February 6th to February 13th! LIQUID will take part in this event, come and trial the game~

LIQUID is a surreal science fiction deduction game. One tricky murder case and different choices, whether to restore the truth or fall into the vortex?

The demo is about 1 hour, and the game is expected to be officially launched in February, follow and wishlist the game, this will be the biggest support to us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095130/_/

notes.title: 超现实主义科幻推理游戏《液化物》Steam页面开启！
notes.content:
[h1]由机械蚂蚱个人独立开发的冒险推理解谜游戏《液化物》Steam页面正式公开了！[/h1]

这是一个关于谋杀迷案上升到探讨精神与灵魂的超现实题材游戏，它拥有众多结局，每个结局都是一种真相，也可能是启发你开启另一个结局的线索。[b]（当当！谜语人环节到了！）[/b]
总之这款十分特别的游戏需要你自己去得出事件真相，这场好戏即将上演，我们将在不久后开放demo，对游戏感兴趣的侦探们可以加入“愿望单”，关注我们的后续进展~~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095130
